access_copy.webdav_token: The complete /dav/<token>/ URL is the credential. Guest or anonymous login without that token has no access.
access_copy.rest_key: Every request must provide the generated API key. Regenerating it immediately revokes clients using the previous key.
access_copy.webdav_changes: Read-only mode permits browsing and downloads. “Allow file changes” additionally permits uploads, moves, renames, and deletes.
access_copy.rest_changes: REST clients can automate the documented file operations available to the local API. Disable the server when the integration is no longer needed.
access_copy.protection_warning: local access does not bypass encryption. The vault may need to be unlocked, and unsupported third-party workflows fail closed rather than receive plaintext.

upload_choice_copy.plain_description: Upload normally for maximum compatibility and easy sharing.
upload_choice_copy.protect_description: Encrypt before upload using your configured protection settings.
upload_choice_copy.load_failed: Upload options could not load. Reloading cancels this selection. Select your files again after the app reloads.

auth_copy.qr_description: Desktop sign-in uses Telegram's QR device flow. A one-time API ID and hash are still required by Telegram to identify this open-source client.
auth_copy.help_intro: Telegram Drive uses your Telegram account as the storage backend for a local-first file workspace. You'll need a Telegram account and API credentials to get started.
auth_copy.portal_instruction: Visit <portal>my.telegram.org</portal> and log in with your phone number.
auth_copy.create_instruction: Click on "API development tools" and create a new application. Use any name and description you like.
auth_copy.copy_instruction: After creating the app, you'll see your {{apiId}} (a number) and {{apiHash}} (a string). Copy both and paste them into the fields on the previous screen.
auth_copy.id_number: API ID must be a number
auth_copy.no_spaces: API ID and API Hash cannot contain spaces. Please remove any spaces.
auth_copy.credentials_required: Both API ID and Hash are required.

drive_intro.drive_title: Your Telegram account becomes the drive
drive_intro.drive_body: Saved Messages is your home storage. Telegram Drive reads and writes files directly through your Telegram session.
drive_intro.folders_body: Creating a folder creates a private Telegram channel owned by your account. The app presents those channels as a familiar drive.
drive_intro.protection_body: Every upload can be stored normally or protected locally before it reaches Telegram. Sharing and WebDAV remain explicit, opt-in actions.

help_topics.storage_answer: Files are Telegram messages in Saved Messages or private channels created as folders. Telegram Drive does not operate a separate cloud storage account.
help_topics.limits_answer: A single Telegram object is limited to 2 GB in this app. Very large folders may take time to index; the live message count shows sync progress.
help_topics.protection_answer: It encrypts file bytes locally before upload. Keep your vault passphrase and recovery bundle safe: Telegram cannot recover protected files for you.
help_topics.sharing_answer: Choose a Telegram channel link, a local password-protected link, or WebDAV/REST. Local servers and capability URLs must be enabled explicitly.
help_topics.guest_question: Why does Finder Guest show an empty folder?
help_topics.guest_answer: WebDAV access is granted by the token embedded in the complete /dav/<token>/ URL. Guest or anonymous login has no token-scoped access.

shortcut_labels.close: Close the active dialog or clear selection

privacy_destinations.device_body: Settings, queue state, thumbnails, and encrypted vault material stay local.
privacy_destinations.telegram_body: Folder channels and uploaded file messages go directly to your Telegram account.
privacy_destinations.sponsors_body: Sponsor content loads only in labeled ad areas. File activity is never sent to sponsors.
privacy_destinations.crash_body: Only after consent: app version, platform, error type, and sanitized function names.

advanced_copy.rest_description: Local automation endpoint and API key

settings_sync_copy.replace_description: The latest encrypted backup came from another device. Uploading will replace it with this device’s current safe preferences.
settings_sync_copy.uploaded: Encrypted settings uploaded to Telegram Saved Messages.
settings_sync_copy.apply_description: Synced display, transfer, network-tuning, and encryption preferences will replace their local values. Credentials and activation data are not changed.
settings_sync_copy.title: Encrypted settings sync
settings_sync_copy.description: Manually move safe app preferences between devices through your own Telegram Saved Messages. Telegram Drive operates no sync server.
settings_sync_copy.exclusions: It is used locally and is never stored or uploaded. The encrypted Telegram message may be visible in Saved Messages. Passwords, API/WebDAV keys, proxy details, supporter activation, crash consent, and file data are always excluded.
settings_sync_copy.none: No encrypted settings backup was found in the latest 1,000 Saved Messages.
